title: Fictional Operations Handbook / Log retention
text: Application logs are retained for 30 days. Security audit logs are retained for 365 days. The platform team removes expired logs automatically each night.

title: Fictional Operations Handbook / Access
text: Production access requires approval from the service owner and completion of security training. Temporary access expires after 24 hours. Access reviews occur every quarter.

title: Fictional Operations Handbook / Incidents
text: For a severity-one incident, the on-call engineer acknowledges the alert within 15 minutes. The incident commander posts updates every 30 minutes until recovery.

title: Fictional Operations Handbook / Backups
text: Database backups run every six hours. Backup recovery is tested monthly. The recovery time objective is four hours and the recovery point objective is six hours.

title: Fictional ML Handbook / Releases
text: A candidate model must pass evaluation on a held-out validation set before promotion. Promotion requires a lower mean absolute error than the incumbent and approval by the model owner.

title: Fictional ML Handbook / Data use
text: Demo datasets must be public or synthetic. Customer records and employee records must not be included in public repositories. Synthetic datasets must be labeled clearly.
